info.title: CT Studio delivery bridge
info.description: Producer API of the delivery bridge. Every /v1 request is signed (x-bridge-timestamp, x-bridge-nonce, x-bridge-signature: HMAC-SHA256 of the method, path, timestamp, nonce and body hash).

post.description: Accepts one package for one or more targets, all or nothing, and queues one delivery per target.

delete.description: Refused with 409 while an unfinished delivery names the target. A removed target keeps its id: putting it again is refused with 409.

post.summary: Read an object of a target
Write an object of a target

post.description: A missing object counts as deleted.

post.summary: Test target settings before saving them

put.description: Used by the producer to move the keys it held for a target onto the bridge. The secret is encrypted on arrival.

delete.description: Called by the producer when a user is disabled. Shared connections stay.

post.summary: Keep the personal connections of live users only
post.description: The producer sends the ids of its live users; the personal connections of anyone else are deleted. An empty list is refused.
